pages.text: How much pressure a hit adds depends on:$(br2)$(li)The weapon's $(l)Overpower level$().$(li)The swing: heavy swings add far more, light swings less, crits more.$(li)The target: tougher enemies resist.

Enemies build pressure on you the same way. Elites (hefty mobs with 40+ health) and bosses push harder.$(br2)$(bold)Ordinary mobs can't break your bar$(): they can only push it to 70. Only elites, bosses and other players can overpower you.
